links.outcome: LLM accuracy in classifying cervical vertebral maturation stage versus orthodontist consensus
links.effect: Exact-match accuracy 14% to 28%; within ±1 stage 55% to 64%; correlations ρ 0.3–0.616; wide limits of agreement.
links.quote: Current LLMs did not exhibit clinically acceptable agreement with expert CVM assessments, showing wide error margins that limit their clinical utility.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the diagnostic performance of multiple multimodal LLMs in evaluating cervical vertebral maturation on lateral cephalometric radiographs without testing a specific deployment practice or organizational safeguard.
